page.layout: One printed page: a single text column on the left, with a narrow margin on the right holding one note (u Psal.108 *). Running head at top left, page number at top right.

main_text.p: inuasit, & ex illustribus & præclaris viris Photinus (Phocæ q; maximè infectus, nam vxorem eius ille constuprarat) cum multitudine magna Imperialem regiâ ingressus, Tyrannum throno suo detraxit, eiq; amicis ministrisq; eius, huc atq; illùc dilapsis, ei purpuream vestem ademit et pullam iniexit, ac mox vinctum ad Heraclium deduxit: ille porrò cum perlibenter id vidit, tum conuitijs plurimis, coniectis calcibus ei insultauit, & statim Tyranno manus & pedes resecari, deinde petulantem eius luxuriâ veluti publico monumento traducens, propterea quòd coniugibus multorum vim intulisset, pudibunda exscindi, postremoq; omnium caput amputari iussit; corpus autem in felicis eius hominis, in Bouem Æneum qui Pergamo allatus fuerat Conijci, Coniectum itaq; in cineres (pro eo atq; par erat) redactum est, genere eius reliquo, vnà cum illo extincto: ] ita perijt Photas Imperatorici-da atq; ita pereant omnes, qui unctum Domini, vel manu, vel lingua, vel calamo, vel cogitatione malitiosa tetigerint. [ u Cùm iudicatur, exeat condemnatus, u Psal.108 *

page.notes: The last line "tus," sits at the lower right of the column, after a line in italic. The reference mark "u" is printed both in the text and in the right margin. The text is transcribed as printed; the words "suo" (printed fuo) and "Photas" follow the long-s forms in the scan. The left edge shows part of the facing page, which is not transcribed.
